title: open.cob.json: An Open Exchange Format for Chip-on-Board Wire Bonding
description:
An open, canonical, machine-readable format for exchanging Chip-on-Board (COB) wire-bonding information between chip designers and PCB designers: die pads, PCB bond fingers and the wires between them, described once and generated from there.

The repository holds the format specification, a JSON Schema, worked examples and tools that turn a description into KiCad symbols and footprints.

Status: work in progress. Nothing here is stable yet; meaningful intermediate states are frozen with git tags and archived as separate versions of this record.
